setup.title: Recording environment
setup.prepareDescription: Check permissions, choose devices, and make a short test recording.
setup.localOnly: Your recordings and voice processing stay on this Mac.
setup.description_welcome: We will check this installation and guide you through each recording setting. Existing projects and scripts stay in place.
setup.heading_permissions: Let Captor capture your screen and mouse activity
setup.description_permissions: Authorize each item once. When you return from System Settings, Captor checks whether access is active for this installation.
setup.heading_devices: Choose what to include in your recording
setup.description_devices: Test your microphone and camera here. Turn off features you do not use; voice following still needs microphone access.
setup.description_voice: Read the test script aloud and watch the highlighted text advance. Test audio is processed locally and is not saved.
setup.heading_trial: Make a short recording, then start using Captor
setup.description_trial: Permissions alone cannot prove recording works. This test checks capture, saving, and video playback together.
setup.screenDescription: Capture the screen or application window you select, including system audio when enabled.
setup.accessibilityDescription: Capture mouse clicks and cursor changes for cursor effects and automatic zoom.
setup.microphoneDescription: Record your narration or follow your voice locally.
setup.cameraDescription: Include your camera picture in recordings when you enable it.
setup.returnFromSettings: Access may need an app restart to take effect. If the switch is already on but this item stays inactive, use the recovery options below.
setup.repairExplanation: First try restarting Captor. If access is still inactive, reset this permission for Captor and authorize it again. Only the selected permission is reset; projects, scripts, models, and other apps are preserved.
setup.identityChanged: This installation differs from the one you configured previously. Check that permissions apply to this copy of Captor.
setup.moveToApplications: Drag Captor into Applications, quit this copy, then open Captor from Applications to continue.
setup.cameraOff: Configured without camera video. You can enable it in recording settings later.
setup.localTest: Speak a few words to check the input. This test does not save audio.
setup.modelSize: About 200 MB. Download once; no account is required.
setup.modelFailed: The model download or integrity check failed. Try again, or turn off voice following on the previous step to use manual prompting.
setup.manualPrompt: Configured for manual prompting. Use the floating prompt controls without downloading a speech model.
setup.trialInstructions: Open the recording controls, select a screen or window, and press Record. Captor stops the test automatically after five seconds. The clip is saved in your recordings folder.
setup.trialVerified: 녹화가 저장되고 영상이 확인되었습니다. 영상을 재생하여 선택한 소리를 확인하세요.
setup.checkFailed: Could not complete this check. Check again to retry.
setup.actionFailed: This action did not complete. Check the current status and try again.
setup.saveWorkFirst: Save your work, stop recording or device tests, and finish exporting or save or close the pending export result before continuing.
setup.environmentNotReady: Some required items are not ready. Complete the highlighted checks first.
setup.mediaUnavailable: Could not use this device. Check its permission and connection, then try again.
setup.deviceDisconnected: The device disconnected. Reconnect it or select another device.
setup.voiceFailed: The voice test stopped. Check the microphone and local model, then try again.
setup.trialFailed: The test did not finish successfully. Check the recording environment and make another test clip.
setup.previewFailed: Could not play the test clip. Make another test recording before finishing setup.
setup.mouseInstructions: Start the test, then click inside this window. Captor checks real mouse events without saving them.
setup.clickHere: Click here to check mouse interaction
setup.mouseFailed: Mouse events are unavailable. Check Accessibility, remove old Captor entries, then quit and reopen the app.
setup.mouseTimeout: No mouse click was received. Start the test again and click the test box with your mouse or trackpad within ten seconds.
setup.voiceFollowOnly: 음성 따라읽기는 마이크를 사용하지만 목소리를 저장하지 않습니다. 영상에 목소리를 넣으려면 마이크 오디오 녹음을 켜세요.
setup.silentRecording: 무음 녹화가 선택되었습니다. 마이크와 시스템 소리가 저장되지 않습니다.
setup.trialMicrophoneInstructions: 시험 녹화 중 한 문장을 말한 뒤 영상을 재생하여 목소리가 들리는지 확인하세요.
setup.trialSystemAudioInstructions: 시험 녹화 중 컴퓨터에서 음악이나 영상을 재생한 뒤 녹화에 그 소리가 포함되었는지 확인하세요.
